Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 200 as introduced would (1) reduce the obligations of the Election Expenses Account funded by State General Fund appropriations by an estimated $888,000 every four years by no longer mailing notices to all registered voters, (2) reduce the obligations of county general funds collectively by an estimated $31,500 every four years, and (3) conversely increase the obligations of the Election Expenses Account by an estimated $31,500 every four years. The total net effect of the provisions of this bill to the Election Expenses Account is an estimated savings of $856,000 every four years.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
